Here’s a quick walk‑through so you can get those five burgers and six chicken wings delivered (or picked up) from **McDonald’s** through Uber Eats: --- ### 📲 How to Order Through the Uber Eats App / Website | Step | What to Do | |------|------------| | **1️⃣ Launch Uber Eats** | Open the *Uber* app → tap “Food” at the bottom, then select “Order Food.” If you’re on desktop, visit [ubereats.com](https://www.uber.com/us/en/food). | | **2️⃣ Set Your Delivery/Pickup Location** | Enter your street address or let GPS auto‑detect it. Make sure the pin lands inside McDonald’s delivery zone. | | **3️⃣ Search for McDonald’s** | Type “McDonald’s” into the search bar. Choose the specific outlet you prefer (e.g., “McDonald’s – Downtown”). | | **4️⃣ Browse & Add Items** | • Tap the menu icon.
• Find the burger section—pick the exact burger(s) you want (e.g., Big Mac, Quarter Pounder, Cheeseburger).
• For each burger, hit “Add,” then adjust the quantity to **5**.
• Next, locate the Chicken Wings item (often under “Sides” or “Chicken”).
• Hit “Add,” then change the quantity to **6**. | | **5️⃣ Review Cart** | Double‑check totals, taxes, and estimated delivery fee. You’ll see something like:
`$X.XX × 5 Burgers` + `$Y.YY × 6 Wings` + `Delivery Fee`. | | **6️⃣ Apply Promo Codes (Optional)** | If you’ve got a promo code (like “SAVE10”), enter it now to reduce cost. | | **7️⃣ Checkout** | • Confirm your delivery address again.
• Select payment method (credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, etc.).
• Optionally toggle “Tip” slider (recommended 15–20% for drivers). | | **8️⃣ Place Order** | Tap “Place Order.” A confirmation screen will show the restaurant name, total price, expected ETA, and a tracking link. | --- ### 🚚 Tracking & Estimated Time - After placing the order, you’ll receive real‑time updates: - **Restaurant Confirmation:** When the kitchen starts preparing your meal. - **Driver Assignment:** Once a driver picks up the order. - **ETA Updates:** Updated arrival times as the driver gets closer. Typical delivery windows vary by region, usually between **25–45 minutes**, depending on traffic and distance. --- ### 🔄 Need Changes? If you realize you’d rather swap one burger for another or tweak wing seasoning after confirming the cart, simply: 1. Go back to the **Cart** page before hitting “Place Order.” 2. Adjust quantities or remove items. 3. Re‑apply promos if needed. Once you click “Place Order,” changes aren’t allowed unless you cancel first. --- ### 💳 Payment Tips - **Cashless only**: Uber Eats doesn’t accept cash payments. Ensure your chosen payment method has enough balance/funds. - **Split Payments**: If sharing the bill, you can split within the app during checkout (available in some regions). --- ### 🎉 Extra Perks - **Free Delivery**: Some restaurants offer free delivery when you spend over a certain threshold (look for banners). - **Loyalty Rewards**: Check if you qualify for Uber Rewards points or partner discounts. --- #### Quick Summary Checklist ``` [ ] Open Uber Eats [ ] Verify delivery/pickup address [ ] Locate McDonald’s outlet [ ] Add 5 burgers (set qty) [ ] Add 6 chicken wings (set qty) [ ] Review cart & apply promo [ ] Confirm payment & tip [ ] Place order [ ] Track until arrival ``` That’s all there is to it! Enjoy your feast. 🍔🍗✨ Let me know if you'd like help finding a particular McDonald’s location nearby or anything else.
